title: EDG Community Update: Week of September 5th, 2022
body:
## **Highlights**

- Introducing [SimpleUI, where you can do more with less](https://twitter.com/EdgewareDAO/status/1567618723854548992)!
- The [Discord Games](https://twitter.com/EdgewareDAO/status/1567120738221432833) aka the 5th campaign from [The Cutting Edge Conquest series](https://gov.edgewa.re/discussion/5848-the-cutting-edge-conquest-a-community-campaigns-series-partially-postpaid) has been kicked off and will run daily at 5 pm UTC until 14th September.
- All the Validators, RPC infrastructure providers, Exchanges and Ecosystem Projects can upgrade their nodes to the [pre-release v3.5.1](https://github.com/edgeware-network/edgeware-node/releases/tag/v3.5.1) to be prepared in advance for the upcoming ERUP5 upgrade's on-chain democracy proposal.
- Upcoming Activities/Events: The Cutting Edge Conquest campaigns(ongoing), ThinkRate AMA ft. Ali Sajadpour

## **Ecosystem Updates**

- [OnFinality published the August 2022 usage report](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1tZJqAC7pHptjbMmZnHcpAEkiKdpG6QUdn6Sx_YNIylY/edit?usp=sharing) of their load-balancing RPC infrastructure (now featuring origins/domains as well) for Edgeware solochain mainnet. Overall there were ~68.99 million requests with ~78.63 GB of data traffic. They also released a new 'Network Insights dashboard' which shows OnFinality's API usage across the Edgeverse and its performance in an hourly manner.
- Get to know more technical-oriented updates on the '[Developer Update aka EDG Dev Digest](https://blog.edgewa.re/edg-developer-update-sep-4/)'.
- Looking for the speculative performance of EDG? Check out the [Community-run DAO Financial Bulletins](https://blog.edgewa.re/tag/bi-weekly/).
- EDGizens are welcome to participate in [the research survey](https://forms.gle/XdjEyBEMY1EtZs3x9) by one of the ecosystem partners.
